machine.name: High-Speed Automated IC Tester & Pick-and-Place Sorter
machine.disclaimer:
SYNTHETIC PROTOTYPE TECHNICAL MANUAL

This document is artificially generated for the VectorAI demonstration and software development.

The specifications, thresholds, service-life values, maintenance intervals, and operating parameters are synthetic and must not be used for real industrial equipment operation or maintenance.
machine.description: Automated Test Equipment (ATE) system integrated with a high-throughput pick-and-place device handler, tri-temperature environmental conditioning chamber, and multi-bin sorter designed to execute parametric and functional electrical validation at speed, sorting verified ICs into pass/fail bins or tape-and-reel carriers.
machine.manufacturingProcess: Packaged integrated circuits are fed from input tubes, trays, or bulk bowls. The high-speed robotic handler picks devices, brings them to temperature in an environmental chamber (-40°C to +125°C), and compresses them into precision pogo-pin test sockets on the Device-Under-Test (DUT) interface board. The ATE instrumentation executes DC parametric, AC timing, and functional RF/digital tests in milliseconds. Tested ICs are sorted into designated bin categories or transferred to high-speed tape-and-reel packaging.
subsystems: Automated High-Speed Pick-and-Place Device Handler & Shuttle
Precision DUT Test Socket Interface & Pogo Pin Array
High-Speed Parametric Measurement Unit (PMU) & Pin Electronics
2D DataMatrix Optical Inspection & Laser Marking Station
Multi-Bin Sorting Shuttles & Tape-and-Reel Packaging Output

components.name: DUT Interface Socket & Pogo Pin Block
components.function: Provides temporary, highly reliable electrical contact to IC package pins/balls with minimal contact resistance and signal distortion.
components.importantParameters: Pogo pin contact resistance (mΩ), compression stroke force (N), contact lifecycle count, socket surface temperature (°C).
components.degradationIndicators: Contact resistance elevation (>85 mΩ), false open-circuit test failures, pogo pin spring fatigue, socket debris buildup.

components.name: High-Speed Handler Robotic Carriage
components.function: Transfers untested chips to test sockets and sorts tested devices into pass/fail bin positions at accelerations up to 15G.
components.importantParameters: Carriage linear vibration (mm/s), positioning repeatability (µm), vacuum pickup seal integrity.
components.degradationIndicators: Handler vibration spikes (>0.90 mm/s), mechanical positioning jitter, device dropping, track belt slack.

components.name: Socket Actuator Press
components.function: Applies programmable compression force to seat device pins firmly into pogo pin matrix during test execution.
components.importantParameters: Actuator compression force (N), descent velocity (mm/s), force planarity balance.
components.degradationIndicators: Actuator force creep (>75 N), lead deformation on packages, pneumatic seal leakage.

components.name: Tri-Temp Environmental Chamber
components.function: Maintains precise device testing temperature from cold test (-40°C) to room temp (25°C) to hot burn-in (125°C).
components.importantParameters: Chamber air temperature (°C), thermal airflow rate (CFM), thermocouple accuracy.
components.degradationIndicators: Chamber temperature drift (>35°C in room test), fan bearing noise, thermal gradient across DUT sites.

components.name: Sorting Shuttle & Tape-and-Reel Unit
components.function: Directs tested ICs into up to 8 bin classes and seals passing units into carrier tape with heated cover tape shoe.
components.importantParameters: Sorting accuracy (µm), sealing shoe temperature (°C), tape peel force (N).
components.degradationIndicators: Sorting positioning error (>15 µm), bin mis-sorting, carrier tape jam, sealing shoe temperature decay.

sensors.name: Handler Vibration
sensors.purpose: Measures X/Y/Z linear motor carriage vibration on the high-speed device transfer handler.

sensors.name: Test Chamber Temp
sensors.purpose: Measures ambient thermal condition inside the device-under-test socket environmental enclosure.

sensors.name: Socket Actuator Load
sensors.purpose: Measures contact compression force exerted when seating chips into the pogo pin test socket.

sensors.name: Pogo Pin Contact Resistance
sensors.purpose: Monitors the average electrical loop resistance across critical power and signal test pins.

sensors.name: Bin Sorting Positional Error
sensors.purpose: Measures positional placement offset when inserting tested devices into sorting output bins.

sensors.name: Socket Surface Temp
sensors.purpose: Monitors localized surface heating of the DUT socket elastomer/PEEK body during continuous testing.

normal.description: Smooth handler carriage traverse and pick-and-place indexing.

warning.description: Linear guide rail dry friction or belt tension relaxation.

critical.description: Severe mechanical guide binding or loose carriage bearings causing device jams.

normal.description: Stable room-temperature parametric testing thermal envelope.

warning.description: Chamber air circulation fan degradation or cleanroom thermal drift.

critical.description: Thermal condition out of specification causing parametric test yield fallout.

normal.description: Nominal compression seating pogo pins to optimal working travel.

warning.description: Actuator friction increase or socket guide pin resistance.

critical.description: Excessive force causing package lead bending or pogo pin destruction.

normal.description: Clean gold/palladium-alloy contact interfaces with minimal voltage drop.

warning.description: Pogo pin tip oxidation or solder plating transfer buildup.

critical.description: Severe contact degradation causing false electrical test failures (Yield crash).

normal.description: High-precision pocket placement into tape pocket or tray.

warning.description: Linear belt stretch or optical encoder scale dust fouling.

critical.description: High risk of device jamming on pocket walls and lead damage.

normal.description: Optimal thermal baseline during high-frequency DUT switching.

warning.description: Localized ohmic heating from elevated pin contact resistance.

critical.description: Dangerous socket heating risking PEEK body softening and pin misregistration.

operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: Automated pogo pin cleaning brush cycle every 5,000 devices; socket life check every 250,000 cycles.
operatingConditions.maximumContinuousOperation: 120 hours before required socket electrical calibration and alignment verification

maintenance.component: DUT Pogo Pin Test Socket Block
maintenance.maintenanceAction: Run automated abrasive brush cycle, clean pin tips with isopropyl alcohol swab, check contact resistance.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Use Kelvin 4-wire micro-ohmmeter on gold test coupon. Replace socket when average resistance > 60 mΩ.

maintenance.component: Handler Robotic Linear Drive Belts & Guides
maintenance.maintenanceAction: Clean linear rails, lubricate guide bearings with cleanroom synthetic grease, check belt tension with sonic meter.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Verify timing belt tension is 85 ± 5 Hz using optical/acoustic tension meter. Inspect belt teeth for wear.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Inspect actuator guide bushings, replace pneumatic cylinder seals, calibrate compression load cell.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Place load cell calibration tool into socket nest; verify actuator delivers exactly 50 ± 2 N.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Clean air circulation blower fans, check thermoelectric Peltier modules, calibrate RTD temperature sensors.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Place 4-wire platinum RTD logger into chamber; verify thermal uniformity across all 4 test sites ± 0.5°C.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Clean Teflon sealing shoe surface, check heater cartridge, perform cover tape peel force test.
maintenance.procedureSummary: Run peel force tester on 500 mm of sealed carrier tape (verify peel force is 30 - 80 gf per EIA-481 standard).

degradationIndicators.normalCondition: Average pin resistance between 25 and 55 mΩ with low variance.
degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Contact resistance climbs to 55 - 85 mΩ due to solder transfer and tip oxidation.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Resistance exceeds 85 mΩ; causes false parametric test bin failures and yield crashes.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Direct physical indication of solder intermetallic transfer, noble metal coating wear, or internal pogo spring fatigue.

degradationIndicators.normalCondition: Vibration amplitude 0.20 - 0.60 mm/s during high-speed indexing.
degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Vibration climbs to 0.60 - 0.90 mm/s due to guide rail dry friction or belt slack.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Vibration exceeds 0.90 mm/s; mechanical resonance causes device pickup misregistration.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates mechanical guide wear, linear motor bearing play, or timing belt tooth wear.

degradationIndicators.degradedCondition: Force climbs to 60 - 75 N as actuator friction increases.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Force exceeds 75 N; high risk of crushing delicate IC package leads.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates pneumatic guide cylinder seal friction, mechanical guide binding, or load cell drift.

degradationIndicators.normalCondition: Maintained strictly at 22 - 28 °C during room temp validation.
degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Temperature exceeds 35 °C; thermal drift alters semiconductor bandgap parameters.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates blower fan failure, thermal insulation loss, or environmental chamber control loop failure.

degradationIndicators.criticalCondition: Positional error exceeds 15 µm; device edges catch on pocket walls causing jams.
degradationIndicators.indicatorMechanism: Indicates timing belt elongation, optical encoder scale contamination, or theta rotational backlash.

rulModel.formulaDescription: Deterministic multi-parameter linear degradation model for IC Tester & Sorter. Weights sum to 1.00.

symptoms.symptom: Pogo Pin Contact Resistance Elevation / False Open Fails
possibleCauses: Solder and tin plating transfer onto gold-plated pogo pin crown tips
Pogo pin internal helical spring fatigue or contact micro-oxidation
Dust and resin particulate accumulation inside socket guide holes
symptoms.recommendedAction: Run automated diamond cleaning brush sequence. If resistance > 60 mΩ persists, replace pogo pin socket insert.

symptoms.symptom: Handler Carriage Vibration Surge / Pick Jitter
possibleCauses: Linear guide rail dry friction and cleanroom grease breakdown
Timing belt tension relaxation or tooth pitch wear
Pick-and-place head mounting screw looseness
symptoms.recommendedAction: Clean linear guides, lubricate with cleanroom grease, adjust timing belt tension to 85 Hz with sonic meter.

symptoms.symptom: Socket Actuator High Compression Force / Lead Bending
possibleCauses: Pneumatic cylinder guide rod mechanical binding
Actuator downward stroke limit stop set too deep
Foreign particle trapped between device nest and socket face
symptoms.recommendedAction: Inspect socket nest for debris, verify actuator load calibration (50 N), lubricate cylinder guide pins.

symptoms.symptom: Test Chamber Temperature Drift / Thermal Yield Shift
possibleCauses: Environmental chamber air circulation fan bearing wear or failure
Thermoelectric Peltier module thermal paste degradation
Chamber thermal door seal gasket air leak
symptoms.recommendedAction: Inspect circulation blower, check Peltier drive current, verify 25.0°C chamber temperature stability.

possibleCauses: Sorting shuttle X/Y positioning belt stretch or encoder skip
Carrier tape sprocket indexing pin wear
Vacuum pickup collet tip wear causing device tilt during placement
symptoms.recommendedAction: Re-teach tape pocket pickup coordinates, replace vacuum collet, clean optical encoder strip.

failureScenarios.symptom: Pogo Pin Solder Transfer & Contact Resistance Spike
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: contact_resistance surges from 38 mΩ to 92 mΩ; false Continuity Fail rate climbs to 4.2%
possibleCauses: Lead-free tin plating transferring from device balls to pogo crown tips
Internal spring relaxation after 200,000 mechanical actuations
Socket guide plate pocket contamination
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Execute 20 strokes with abrasive cleaning coupon. Replace socket insert if resistance remains > 60 mΩ.
verificationSteps: Run automated socket diagnostic self-test with gold coupon
Verify pin resistance < 40 mΩ across all channels

failureScenarios.symptom: Handler Carriage Timing Belt Tooth Wear & Vibration
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: vibration_handler rises from 0.42 to 0.94 mm/s; sorting_accuracy error jumps to 16.5 µm
possibleCauses: Kevlar timing belt tooth shear wear after 2,000 operating hours
Belt tension dropped below 60 Hz
Linear guide bearing ball recirculation fatigue
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace timing belt, adjust tension to 85 Hz using acoustic meter, clean and re-grease linear rails.

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: load_actuator climbs from 50 N to 78 N; cycle time delay alert
possibleCauses: Pneumatic cylinder piston rod seal friction and contamination
Socket guide bushing misaligned
Force sensor amplifier baseline drift
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace pneumatic actuator seal kit. Re-align socket guide pins. Calibrate force sensor.
verificationSteps: Perform 50 actuation cycles with load cell tool

failureScenarios.symptom: Test Chamber Air Blower Fan Bearing Failure
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: temperature_chamber rises from 24.5°C to 36.8°C; thermal gradient alert
possibleCauses: Circulation fan brushless motor bearing seizure
Peltier cooling heat sink fins clogged with dust
Chamber intake air filter restriction
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace circulation blower fan. Clean heat sink radiator fins. Replace intake air filter.

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: Cover tape peel force drops below 20 gf (carrier open defect risk)
possibleCauses: Sealing shoe heater cartridge resistance increase
Teflon tape build-up on sealing shoe blade
Thermocouple probe loose
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Clean sealing shoe with brass brush, replace heater element if resistance > 120 Ω, verify 160°C setpoint.
verificationSteps: Run peel force test on 1 meter of sealed tape (target 45 ± 10 gf)

failureScenarios.symptom: Vacuum Pickup Collet Tip Contamination and Device Drop
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: Handler pickup error rate climbs to 1.8%; vibration_handler nominal
possibleCauses: Silicone suction cup rim coated with package mold compound dust
Vacuum solenoid valve response delayed
Vacuum generator venturi clogged
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Clean suction cup tips with IPA swab. Inspect vacuum level (min -75 kPa).
verificationSteps: Run 200 dummy devices in loop mode

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: Vision scan timeout increases by 15 ms per device; occasional unreadable ID
possibleCauses: Optical scanner window coated with cleanroom dust film
Laser scanner focal distance drifted due to bracket vibration
LED illumination ring half-channel failure
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Clean scanner optical window with lens tissue. Recalibrate focal distance and illumination.

failureScenarios.symptom: Pogo Pin Breakage Causing Short Circuit on DUT Site
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: contact_resistance on Channel 4 reads 0.0 mΩ (short) or infinite (open)
possibleCauses: Mechanical fatigue fracture of internal pin spring
Foreign metallic burr bridging adjacent socket pins
Socket guide plate cracked
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Remove socket block immediately. Replace broken pogo pin using pin insertion tool.

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: sorting_accuracy theta error increases to ± 1.2 degrees
possibleCauses: Harmonic drive theta gearbox wear
Theta stepper motor coupling set screw loose
Rotary optical home sensor dirty
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Tighten motor shaft coupling set screw with threadlocker. Clean home optical sensor.

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: ESD grounding monitor alert; resistance climbs from 0.8 Ω to 15.4 Ω
possibleCauses: Handler wrist strap grounding wire braid broken
Conductive table mat ground snap corroded
Socket grounding bus connection loose
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace ESD grounding cable. Clean ground lug interface with wire brush. Verify resistance < 1.0 Ω.
verificationSteps: Measure point-to-ground resistance with calibrated megohmmeter (< 1.0 Ω)

failureScenarios.symptom: Carrier Tape Sprocket Hole Indexer Tooth Wear
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: Tape feeder jam alert; sorting_accuracy in tape direction drifts ± 20 µm
possibleCauses: Sprocket wheel teeth worn down from continuous plastic tape indexing
Feeder advance stepper belt loose
Cover tape peel tension too high pulling carrier backward
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace indexing sprocket wheel. Calibrate tape advance pitch to 4.00 ± 0.02 mm.
verificationSteps: Verify pocket center alignment with vision camera

failureScenarios.symptom: DUT Test Head Docking Latch Play
failureScenarios.sensorPattern: contact_resistance values fluctuate across all pins when handler vibrates
possibleCauses: Pneumatic docking latch mechanism air pressure low
Docking alignment guide pins worn
Test head stiffener frame clamping torque uneven
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Inspect docking latch air pressure (min 0.55 MPa). Replace worn docking guide pins.
verificationSteps: Execute docking repeatable contact resistance test

failureScenarios.sensorPattern: test_socket_temperature climbs from 28°C to 44.5°C during continuous DC stress test
possibleCauses: High current power pin pogo resistance elevated causing I²R ohmic heating
Socket thermal cooling airflow obstructed
Continuous high duty cycle testing without dwell time
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace high-current pogo pins with heavy-duty crown pins. Clean socket bottom cooling channels.
verificationSteps: Thermal camera inspection of socket under full test load
